caption: The video captures a close-up, eye-level view of a dining table where a column of pale steam rises from the mouth of a cream-and-brown ceramic mug. The mug sits in the foreground on a bamboo-slat placemat, with an empty white plate to its right and a metal knife resting on a folded red napkin to its left. Behind it, an out-of-focus doorway, a dark appliance with a bright white square panel, and an upholstered chair appear fixed. Above the rim, the vapor shifts shape, at the outset a thin, gently wavy vertical ribbon. A compact, rounded puff forms just above the opening and drifts upward, elongating and curling as it rises. Faint separate wisps trail higher against the bright background. The cloud broadens into a more turbulent mass with darker, broken strands near the rim before thinning again into curling ribbons that lean slightly to the left. Throughout, the visible motion is mainly the vapor deforming and rising; the solid setting appears unchanged, and the process is already underway and still continuing.

draft_caption: The video captures a close-up, eye-level view of a dining table where a column of pale steam rises continuously from the mouth of a white ceramic mug. The mug sits centered in the foreground on a bamboo-slat placemat, with an empty white plate to its right and a metal knife resting on a folded red napkin to its left. Behind it, an out-of-focus doorway, a dark appliance with a bright white square panel, and an upholstered chair remain fixed. Above the rim, the vapor shifts shape from frame to frame, at the outset a thin, gently wavy vertical ribbon. A compact, rounded puff forms just above the opening and drifts upward, elongating and curling as it rises. Faint separate wisps trail higher against the bright background. The cloud broadens into a more turbulent mass with darker, broken strands hugging the rim before thinning again into curling ribbons that lean slightly to the left. Throughout, only the vapor deforms and translates. No solid object moves, and the rising process is already underway and still continuing.
